Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie.model

Class ClientExceptionsNotifierImpl

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.utils.Observable<ExceptionEvent,ClientExceptionsNotifierModelView>
it.polimi.myshelfie.model.ClientExceptionsNotifierImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientExceptionsNotifier
public class ClientExceptionsNotifierImpl extends Observable<ExceptionEvent,ClientExceptionsNotifierModelView> implements ClientExceptionsNotifier
Is used to notify all the exceptions. It contains a list with all the exceptions and methods to notify them whenever one occurs.
